problems.explain: 1 : 20 means every length on the real house is 20 times the model’s, in the same unit. 4.5 × 20 = 90 cm. There are 100 cm in a meter: 90 ÷ 100 = 0.9. (The scale has no units of its own, so the answer comes out in cm first.) So 0.9 m.

problems.explain: 1 : 50 means every length on the real ship is 50 times the model’s, in the same unit. 47 × 50 = 2350 cm. There are 100 cm in a meter: 2350 ÷ 100 = 23.5. (The scale has no units of its own, so the answer comes out in cm first.) So 23.5 m.
